lessons.trigger_condition: V408 code-and-data review found lifecycle=current promotions whose event end_date had passed while a verified claim_deadline remained open, plus HOT candidate arrays that were globally truncated to 40 rows before the user-selected game and region lens was applied.
lessons.prevention_rule: Treat a verified promotion as current while any declared operational end_date or claim_deadline remains active; continue excluding tracking-only rows; scan a bounded 5000 verified candidates and apply the reversible game/region lens before the final HOT top-5; keep price direction, user behavior, source generation, Git writes and direct neural authority disabled.
validation_required: an expired end_date does not mask a later verified claim_deadline
rows are excluded when every declared event or claim deadline is expired
market lens candidate scan is bounded to 5000 rows per verified dataset
game and region filtering occurs before final HOT top-5 selection
Pokémon, ONE PIECE, NARUTO and KR, JP, US allowlists remain unchanged
17→12→18 screen neural Champion/Challenger, drift hold and rollback gates remain unchanged
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V409 corrects verified promotion lifecycle attention and HOT candidate selection order only. It does not infer market direction or prices, invent grade/stock/release/event facts, persist precise location or behavior, generate/rewrite runtime source, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main or bypass verification.
